svg.title: Plan, report and predict with IBM
svg.desc: Three steps on one line. Plan: budgets, plans and forecasts in IBM Planning Analytics, powered by the IBM TM1 engine. Report: reports and dashboards on certified data models in IBM Cognos Analytics. Predict: models built on a visual canvas in IBM SPSS Modeler, and testing, regression and forecasting in IBM SPSS Statistics.
